Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 133. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Weapon technique
Ki Cost: 18 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee
Weapon that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
A wild flurry of swings that is hard to match. Make a
combo attack roll dealing your equipped weapon’s
damage die + 2d6 damage. This attack has advantage
on clash checks.
